diagnostic.section.title: Diagnostics
diagnostic.verbose.label: Detailed logging
diagnostic.verbose.description: Records routine events (loading, saving, and generation) in the log file, along with errors. This helps provide context when you report a bug in a GitHub issue. When disabled, only warnings and errors are recorded.
diagnostic.folder.label: Log folder
diagnostic.privacy.description: The file may contain local paths (file names, user folder). Check its contents before sharing it publicly.

projects.section.title: Project and media management
projects.workspace.label: Use the workspace folder for new projects
projects.workspace.description: Off by default: new projects start in a temporary session. When you first save them, their media files move to the workspace folder.
projects.location.label: Workspace folder
projects.location.description: The main folder for saved projects and managed media files.
projects.copy.label: Copy imported files to the workspace folder
projects.consolidate.label: Consolidate project
projects.consolidate.description: Copies the `.mbah` file and all media files used by the project to a destination folder, keeping the originals.
save.section.title: Saving
save.auto.label: Autosave
save.auto.description: On by default: saves the project every 5 minutes if there are unsaved changes. A project that has never been saved is copied to the sauvegardes/ folder inside the workspace folder.
save.backups.label: Backup versions
save.backups.description: Number of `.mbah` backup copies to keep before each autosave.

youtube.section.title: YouTube (yt-dlp)
youtube.help.description: The “Create an audiobook from YouTube” guided flow automatically downloads yt-dlp the first time you use it and keeps it up to date. It also installs and updates the Deno JavaScript engine (about 40 MB), which yt-dlp needs to access YouTube reliably. YouTube blocks outdated versions, so you only need these settings if you run into a problem.
youtube.update.label: Update yt-dlp now
youtube.update.description: Downloads the latest version of yt-dlp and installs the JavaScript engine if it’s missing. Use this if an import fails because the version is outdated.
